DKU Library — August 2021 student handbook (superseded)

This extract is from an August 2021 DKU Student Handbook. It is kept as historical text. It does not describe the current dedicated library building.

retrieved_chunks.title: Wuhan University
retrieved_chunks.text:
Wuhan University (partner institution, not the DKU campus)

Wuhan University is in Hubei province in central China. It is a partner in Duke Kunshan University. It is not in Kunshan and is not the DKU library, dining halls, or registrar.

Wuhan University's history is traced to the Ziqiang Institute founded in 1893 by Zhang Zhidong. In 1928 the institute was renamed Wuhan National University.

This note does not list DKU class dates, DKU library hours, or Wuhan University library hours.

retrieved_chunks.title: Duke University Durham
retrieved_chunks.text:
more than 15,000 students in undergraduate, graduate, and professional programs.

Duke University Libraries (including Perkins and Bostock on West Campus) are in Durham. They are not the DKU Library at No. 8 Duke Avenue, Kunshan. This note does not list Perkins closing times, because those hours are not copied here.

DKU is described on Duke's international activity list alongside Duke-NUS in Singapore.
